name: gc-group-authz-flag — 공유→그룹전환·사이드바 배지·그룹 비멘션 서버방어·owner 리네임 (authed, PB-0008)

steps.script: (async()=>{const cid=window.__pb_cid;const lr=await fetch('/api/conversations');const lj=await lr.json();const items=(lj.conversations||lj.items||lj||[]);const c=items.find(x=>String(x.id)===String(cid));const isG=(typeof isGroupConversation==='function')?isGroupConversation(c):null;return JSON.stringify({cid:cid,is_group_after:Boolean(c&&c.is_group),member_count_after:Number((c&&c.member_count)||0),isGroupConversation_helper:isG});})()

(async()=>{const cid=window.__pb_cid;const model=(state&&(state.selectedModel||state.model))|| (window.MODELS&&window.MODELS[0])||'';const r=await fetch('/api/ask',{method:'POST',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({conversation_id:cid,message:'팀 여러분 안녕하세요 (멘션 없는 사람채팅)',model:model})});let body=null;try{body=await r.json();}catch(e){}return JSON.stringify({ask_status:r.status,ask_code:(body&&body.code)||null,model_used:model,note:'그룹+비멘션 → 422 group_requires_mention 이면 assistant 미실행(#2 서버방어)'});})()

(async()=>{const cid=window.__pb_cid;const r=await fetch('/api/conversations/'+encodeURIComponent(cid)+'/title',{method:'PATCH',headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({title:String(window.__pb_topic||'대화')})});return JSON.stringify({owner_rename_status:r.status,owner_rename_ok:r.ok,note:'owner 본인 리네임은 통과해야 함(#1 무회귀)'});})()

(async()=>{ if(typeof loadConversations==='function'){try{await loadConversations();}catch(e){}} if(typeof renderConversationList==='function'){try{renderConversationList();}catch(e){}} await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800)); const badges=document.querySelectorAll('#conversationList .conv-item-group-badge'); const groupItems=document.querySelectorAll('#conversationList .conv-item.is-group'); return JSON.stringify({group_badge_count:badges.length, is_group_item_count:groupItems.length, note:'사이드바 그룹 배지(#3)'});})()
